validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript">
  <datamodel><data id="x" expr="1"/></datamodel>
  <state id="a"><transition event="go" cond="x < 3" target="f"/></state><final id="f"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: unescaped `<` in the value of attribute `cond`

primary.message: a literal `<` is not allowed in an attribute value

notes: the parser cannot tell a literal `<` from the start of a tag, so XML forbids it in attribute values; `>` needs no escaping
spec_references: XML 1.0 (Fifth Edition) §3.1 Start-Tags (WFC: No < in Attribute Values)
